title: B2B Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist
company: Thomas Lee Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Engineering Products Data-Driven Marketing International Markets

Location: Shrewsbury, Shropshire

Salary: £37,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-time, Maternity Cover

Future Opportunity: Potential for a permanent position

The Opportunity

We're recruiting for an established engineering products business looking for a commercially minded B2 B marketing professional to support its UK and international sales operations.

This isn't simply a role creating social media posts, writing newsletters or maintaining a website.

We're looking for someone who can take information, understand the market, develop targeted marketing strategies and, importantly, turn that activity into genuine sales opportunities.

Working closely with the sales team, you'll use customer data, market research, digital marketing, AI and modern marketing technology to identify potential customers, build campaigns and generate qualified leads.

This is a hands-on, varied position within an SME engineering environment, where you'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table and see the commercial impact of your work.

What You'll Be Doing

Marketing Strategy & Data Analysis
- Analyse existing customer, prospect and marketing data to identify trends and opportunities.
- Research new markets, industries and potential customers across the UK and internationally.
- Develop practical marketing strategies to support commercial growth.
- Identify target customer groups and build focused marketing campaigns.
- Use campaign performance data to continually improve results.

Lead Generation & Sales Support
- Develop and execute campaigns designed to generate qualified sales enquiries.
- Identify potential customers and commercially relevant opportunities.
- Work closely with the sales team to understand their requirements.
- Provide sales colleagues with useful prospect information and actionable leads.
- Track lead generation, engagement and campaign effectiveness.

Digital Marketing & Content
- Plan and deliver B2 B email marketing campaigns.
- Create relevant content for websites, digital channels and marketing communications.
- Support SEO, online visibility and product marketing activities.
- Communicate the benefits of specialist engineering products to different customer audiences.
- Maintain consistent and professional marketing communications.

AI & Marketing Technology
- Use AI tools to support market research, data analysis, content development and campaign planning.
- Make effective use of CRM, marketing automation and digital marketing platforms.
- Explore ways to improve marketing efficiency through technology.
- Research and adopt suitable new tools where they add genuine commercial value.
- Ensure marketing information is accurate, relevant and handled appropriately.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with marketing professionals who enjoy combining analytical thinking with practical campaign delivery.

You might currently be working as a Marketing Executive, Senior Marketing Executive, B2 B Marketing Specialist or within a similar commercially focused marketing position.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in B2 B marketing.
- Experience developing and delivering marketing campaigns.
- An understanding of lead generation and how marketing supports sales.
- Confidence analysing data and identifying commercial opportunities.
- Experience using CRM systems and digital marketing tools.
- An interest in AI and how it can improve marketing research and productivity.
- Good communication, organisation and content development skills.
- The ability to work independently and manage different marketing activities.
- A commercially minded approach with a focus on measurable results.

Experience within engineering, manufacturing, industrial products or technical distribution would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in candidates from other B2 B environments with transferable experience.

You don't need to be an expert in every marketing platform. We're more interested in someone who understands how to use information, technology and marketing techniques to achieve results.

What's on Offer?
- £37,000 annual salary.
- A varied, hands-on marketing position.
- Exposure to UK and international engineering markets.
- The opportunity to use AI and modern marketing technology.
- Close involvement with sales and business development.
- A chance to contribute ideas and influence marketing activity.
- Potential for permanent employment following the maternity-cover period, depending on business requirements.

The Right Person

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding markets, developing ideas and putting them into practice.

Someone who doesn't just measure success by how many emails are sent or how many posts are published, but by whether their marketing activity generates useful opportunities for the business.

If you have a background in B2 B marketing, enjoy using data and technology, and want a position where your work has a direct commercial impact, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

About Us

At Thomas Lee Recruitment, we specialise in connecting engineers and technical salespeople with leading companies in the engineering sector. We pride ourselves on offering a personalised, professional, and transparent recruitment service. Our focus is on understanding both client and candidate needs to ensure the best possible match.

How to Apply

All applications will be responded to. Please ensure you have the right to work in the UK before applying.

By applying for this role, you accept our Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, and Disclaimers, which can be found on our website.

title: First Point of Contact Administrator
description:
First Point of Contact Administrator

Location: Shrewsbury
Salary: £25,500 per annum increasing to £26,600 after probation
Job Type: Full Time
Training & Support: Full training provided

We are currently recruiting for a First Point of Contact Administrator to join a busy property management team based in Shrewsbury.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service, administration and communication skills who is looking to develop their career within the property sector. Full training and ongoing support will be provided.

The Role

As the first point of contact, you will play an important role in providing a professional and efficient service to clients, customers, contractors and leaseholders.

You will be responsible for handling incoming calls and emails, dealing with routine enquiries and ensuring more complex queries are directed to the appropriate Property Manager or department.

Key Responsibilities
- Answer incoming telephone calls and emails, providing a professional and helpful first point of contact.
- Handle routine client and customer enquiries and accurately triage more complex queries.
- Direct calls and correspondence to the appropriate Property Manager or internal department.
- Prepare and issue general correspondence to clients and leaseholders.
- Assist Property Managers and Department Heads with client, contractor and customer communications.
- Upload and maintain documentation across internal systems.
- Manage appointments and oversee the Shrewsbury office diary.
- Liaise with internal teams to obtain and provide information relating to property portfolios.
- Attend internal meetings where required.
- Ensure all work is carried out in line with relevant industry guidelines and best practice.
- Complete mandatory training and participate in additional training where appropriate.
- Maintain high standards of customer service and ensure customers are treated fairly.
- Keep up to date with relevant legislation and industry developments.
- Work collaboratively as part of a wider property management team.

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Customer-focused with a professional and friendly approach.
- Confident communicating by telephone, email and in person.
- Highly organised with good attention to detail.
- Comfortable managing multiple enquiries and prioritising workload.
- IT literate and confident using internal systems.
- A strong team player who is willing to learn and develop.
- Reliable, punctual and professional.
- Previous experience in administration, customer service, property or a similar environment would be beneficial, although not essential.

What's on Offer?
- £25,500 per annum increasing to £26,600 after probation
- Full training and ongoing support
- Opportunity to develop a career within the property management sector
- Supportive team environment
- Excellent opportunity for someone looking to establish themselves within residential property

If you're organised, personable and looking for an opportunity to build your career within property, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Stock Control & Purchasing Coordinator
description:
Supply Chain Development within a Leading Equipment Supplier
Location - Shrewsbury
Salary: up to 40,000 pa + Benefits
Are you an experienced Stock Control or Purchasing professional looking for a varied role where you can take ownership of inventory management, purchasing and supplier relationships?
We are working with an established business looking to appoint a proactive and organised Stock Control & Purchasing Coordinator to support its operational requirements and ensure the efficient availability of materials, products and equipment.
The Role
You will play an important part in managing stock levels and coordinating purchasing activities, ensuring materials are available when needed while maintaining accurate records and controlling inventory costs.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Monitoring stock levels and raising purchase orders to meet operational requirements.
- Managing the purchasing process from obtaining supplier quotations through to order placement and delivery.
- Using SAP to maintain accurate inventory records, process purchase orders and manage goods receipts.
- Liaising with suppliers to track deliveries, resolve shortages and investigate stock discrepancies.
- Maintaining appropriate inventory levels while minimising excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock.
- Coordinating the supply of materials, equipment and consumables to support day-to-day operations.
- Monitoring supplier performance, pricing and lead times, identifying opportunities for improved efficiency and cost control.
- Producing stock, purchasing and supplier reports using SAP, Excel and other IT systems.
- Working closely with warehouse, finance and operational teams to ensure purchasing and stock control processes run smoothly.

About You

We're keen to speak with individuals who have previous experience in stock control, purchasing, procurement, materials management or supply chain coordination.
You'll ideally bring:
- Practical experience using SAP or a similar ERP system within a purchasing or inventory environment - essential.
- Strong Microsoft Office and Excel skills.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines.
- Good communication and supplier relationship management skills.
- A proactive, methodical and solutions-focused approach to resolving supply and stock issues.

Experience within a manufacturing, engineering, warehouse or wider operational environment would be particularly advantageous.
Interested?
This is an excellent opportunity to join an established operation in a varied position combining purchasing, stock management and supplier coordination. If this sounds like the right next step in your career, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your full CV, quoting reference number 10576.

title: Technical Sales & Service Co-ordinator
description:
Technical Support Service Coordination Customer Development
Location - Shrewsbury
Remuneration - Up to £40,000 p.a. + Benefits

Technical Sales and Customer Support within a leading equipment supplier

Are you someone who combines strong customer service skills with a technical mindset and a commercial approach? Do you enjoy solving problems, coordinating repairs and identifying opportunities to generate additional business?

An established engineering and equipment business is looking to recruit a Technical Sales & Service Coordinator to join its team. This is a varied, customer-facing role combining technical support, service and repair coordination, and proactive sales activity. You'll become a key point of contact for customers, ensuring machine issues are resolved efficiently while maximising opportunities to generate revenue through servicing, maintenance, spare parts and equipment sales.

The Role

You'll take ownership of customer service requests and repairs from initial enquiry through to completion, while proactively developing existing customer relationships.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Providing telephone and email technical support, troubleshooting machine faults and advising customers on solutions.
- Identifying spare parts requirements and preparing technical information, diagrams and quotations.
- Coordinating engineers, repair schedules, machine collections and returns.
- Managing service calls, repair records and invoicing through SAP.
- Reviewing engineer reports, assessing warranty coverage and recommending repair, replacement or write-off.
- Preparing quotations, obtaining customer approvals and managing chargeable repair work.
- Managing existing service and maintenance agreements, ensuring work is completed on time.
- Proactively contacting existing customers to promote service visits, maintenance packages and spare parts.
- Identifying opportunities to upsell accessories, replacement equipment and additional services.

The Commercial Opportunity

This isn't simply a service administration position. You'll play an active role in developing existing customer accounts and generating additional revenue through proactive customer engagement.

You'll be expected to:
- Make proactive customer calls per day.
- Convert a solid level of quoted proactive service opportunities into confirmed orders.
- Follow up quotations and turn service recommendations into sales.
- Work alongside the Sales Team to maximise opportunities with new and existing customers.

Who are we Looking For?

We're interested in people who can demonstrate:
- Experience in technical sales, engineering, equipment sales or service coordination.
- Strong customer service and communication skills.
- The ability to understand technical issues and confidently discuss solutions with customers.
- Excellent organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Commercial awareness, with confidence discussing costs, quotations and sales opportunities.
- Experience using business systems and IT packages to manage service jobs and customer records.
- You'll be proactive, commercially minded and comfortable picking up the phone to customers.
- You'll enjoy finding solutions, building relationships and seeing opportunities through to completion.

Interested?

If you have a background in technical sales, engineering support, service coordination or equipment sales and are looking for a role that combines technical variety with commercial responsibility, w e would be keen to hear from you. This is a confidential recruitment assignment, with further details available during an initial conversation. Please apply with your full CV quoting reference 10573.

title: Technical Sales and Service Coordinator
description:
SF Partners are supporting an established Shrewsbury SW1 based business that are looking to recruit a Technical Sales and Service Coordinator on a permanent basis.

Salary: £35,000-£45,000
Working pattern: full time site based

We are seeking an experienced Technical Sales and Service Co-Ordinator to provide professional support to customers and internal departments throughout the sales and service process. The successful candidate will have previous experience in a similar role, the ability to interpret technical drawings, and a proven track record of providing technical advice, coordinating appointments, resolving customer issues, and arranging collections and deliveries. Proficiency in SAP is essential.
Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries, providing accurate technical and product information.
- Read, interpret and apply technical drawings, specifications and associated documentation.
- Advise customers on appropriate products, services and technical solutions in accordance with their requirements.
- Prepare, process and follow up quotations, orders and service-related documentation.
- Arrange and co-ordinate customer appointments, site visits, installations, inspections and service callouts.
- Arrange the collection and delivery of products, equipment and materials in liaison with customers, drivers, suppliers and relevant internal departments.
- Monitor orders and service requests, providing customers with timely updates regarding progress, delivery schedules and any changes.
- Investigate and resolve customer queries and service issues efficiently, escalating complex matters where appropriate.
- Maintain accurate customer, order, delivery and service records within SAP and other relevant business systems.
- Work collaboratively with the sales, service, warehouse, transport and technical teams to ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities.
- Provide support with stock management, returns, warranty claims and after-sales service processes as required.
- Ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with company procedures, regulatory requirements and established customer service

Desirable Experience
- Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, industrial or other technical environment.
- Experience coordinating deliveries, collections, installations or field-service activities.
- Familiarity with quotations, purchase orders, sales orders, returns and warranty processes.
- A relevant technical qualification or industry-specific training.
